Trend vs 50/100/200-day averages: S&P 500: Caution, Nasdaq 100: Bear, Dow Jones: Caution, Russell 2000: Bear, S&P 500 Equal Weight: Bull.

Breadth (all S&P 500 stocks): 71% above their 50-day average, 64% above their 200-day; 54 new 52-week highs vs 5 new lows; 396 stocks rose this week, 104 fell.

How we score it: Risk-on when the S&P 500 is above all three averages, most stocks are above their 200-day and new highs outnumber new lows; Risk-off when the trend or breadth breaks down; Neutral in between.

The Price of Momentum: Deeper Falls, Higher Long-Run Returns 📉📈

Worst fall since 2005: Nifty200 Momentum 30 -68% vs Nifty 200 -64%.
Today: Momentum is -19.4% below its peak; Nifty 200 -3.1%.
10-year CAGR: Momentum 15.6% vs Nifty 200 12.4%.

Momentum's long-run edge comes with sharp drawdowns. That's why a systematic framework sizes it sensibly and uses rules, not emotions, to stay the course.
